message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
for n in [1000,5000,20000,50000,100000,200000,500000]:
    s=('ip or '*n)+'ip'
    p=f'/workspace/poc_or_{n}'
    open(p,'wb').write(s.encode()+b'\x01')
    print(p, len(s)+1)
PY
ls -lh /workspace/poc_or_* | tail
